mapper.sql:
simulation_original_route AS ( SELECT r.route_id, r.fid AS route_fid, r.rname AS route_name,
ST_Transform( ST_LineMerge(r.geom), 32650 ) AS original_metric_line
FROM public.routes r
WHERE r.route_id = #{routeId} AND ST_GeometryType( ST_LineMerge(r.geom) ) = 'ST_LineString' ),
simulation_source_stops AS ( SELECT rs.route_id, rs.stop_id, s.stop_name, rs.stop_sequence,
ST_Transform( s.geom, 32650 ) AS metric_stop,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY rs.route_id ORDER BY rs.stop_sequence ) AS stop_order,
COUNT(*) OVER ( PARTITION BY rs.route_id ) AS stop_count
FROM public.route_stops rs
JOIN public.stops s ON s.stop_id = rs.stop_id
JOIN simulation_original_route route ON route.route_id = rs.route_id ),
simulation_endpoint_context AS ( SELECT route.*,
first_stop.metric_stop AS first_metric_stop,
last_stop.metric_stop AS last_metric_stop,
/* * 首末站都靠近原始几何端点时， * 保留完整线路并维持 M103、M120 的原有行为。 */ ( ST_DWithin( first_stop.metric_stop, ST_StartPoint( route.original_metric_line ), #{maximumSnapOffsetMeters} ) AND ST_DWithin( last_stop.metric_stop, ST_EndPoint( route.original_metric_line ), #{maximumSnapOffsetMeters} ) ) AS original_endpoints_valid
FROM simulation_original_route route
JOIN simulation_source_stops first_stop ON first_stop.route_id = route.route_id AND first_stop.stop_order = 1
JOIN simulation_source_stops last_stop ON last_stop.route_id = route.route_id AND last_stop.stop_order = last_stop.stop_count
/* * 一条只有零个或一个站点的线路， * 无法可靠确定有效模拟区间。 */ WHERE first_stop.stop_count >= 2 ),
simulation_original_segments AS ( SELECT context.route_id, dump.path[1] AS segment_index, dump.geom AS segment_geom,
ST_Length( dump.geom ) AS segment_length_meters,
COALESCE( SUM( ST_Length(dump.geom) ) OVER ( PARTITION BY context.route_id ORDER BY dump.path[1] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING ), 0.0 ) AS segment_start_distance_meters,
ST_Length( context.original_metric_line ) AS original_length_meters
FROM simulation_endpoint_context context
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_DumpSegments( context.original_metric_line ) AS dump ),
/* * 只有原始端点不匹配时，才需要寻找首末站投影。 * ORIGINAL_LINE 不会执行后面的截取选择。 */ simulation_endpoint_rows AS ( SELECT route_id, 'FIRST' AS endpoint_kind, first_metric_stop AS metric_stop
FROM simulation_endpoint_context
WHERE NOT original_endpoints_valid
UNION ALL
SELECT route_id, 'LAST' AS endpoint_kind, last_metric_stop AS metric_stop
FROM simulation_endpoint_context
WHERE NOT original_endpoints_valid ),
simulation_endpoint_candidates AS ( SELECT endpoint.route_id, endpoint.endpoint_kind,
( segment.segment_start_distance_meters + segment.segment_length_meters * ST_LineLocatePoint( segment.segment_geom, endpoint.metric_stop ) ) / segment.original_length_meters AS progress_ratio,
ST_Distance( segment.segment_geom, endpoint.metric_stop ) AS snap_offset_meters,
/* * 连续的候选线段拥有相同 candidate_group。 * * 如果一个站点靠近两个不连续区间， * 就会产生两个 candidate_group， * 此时不能自动判断应该选择哪一段。 */ segment.segment_index - ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY endpoint.route_id, endpoint.endpoint_kind ORDER BY segment.segment_index ) AS candidate_group
FROM simulation_endpoint_rows endpoint
JOIN simulation_original_segments segment ON segment.route_id = endpoint.route_id
WHERE ST_DWithin( segment.segment_geom, endpoint.metric_stop, #{maximumSnapOffsetMeters} ) ),
simulation_endpoint_choices AS ( SELECT route_id, endpoint_kind,
COUNT( DISTINCT candidate_group ) AS candidate_group_count,
/* * 只有一个候选区间时， * 选择该区间中偏移最小的精确投影点。 */ ( ARRAY_AGG( progress_ratio ORDER BY snap_offset_meters, progress_ratio ) )[1] AS selected_progress_ratio
FROM simulation_endpoint_candidates
GROUP BY route_id, endpoint_kind ),
simulation_route_choice AS ( SELECT route_id,
MAX(candidate_group_count) FILTER ( WHERE endpoint_kind = 'FIRST' ) AS first_candidate_group_count,
MAX(candidate_group_count) FILTER ( WHERE endpoint_kind = 'LAST' ) AS last_candidate_group_count,
MAX(selected_progress_ratio) FILTER ( WHERE endpoint_kind = 'FIRST' ) AS first_progress_ratio,
MAX(selected_progress_ratio) FILTER ( WHERE endpoint_kind = 'LAST' ) AS last_progress_ratio
FROM simulation_endpoint_choices
GROUP BY route_id ),
simulation_selected_route AS ( SELECT context.route_id, context.route_fid, context.route_name, context.original_metric_line,
CASE WHEN context.original_endpoints_valid THEN 'ORIGINAL_LINE' ELSE 'SUBSTRING_LINE' END AS line_strategy,
CASE WHEN context.original_endpoints_valid THEN 0.0::double precision ELSE choice.first_progress_ratio END AS source_start_progress_ratio,
CASE WHEN context.original_endpoints_valid THEN 1.0::double precision ELSE choice.last_progress_ratio END AS source_end_progress_ratio
FROM simulation_endpoint_context context
LEFT JOIN simulation_route_choice choice ON choice.route_id = context.route_id
WHERE context.original_endpoints_valid OR ( choice.first_candidate_group_count = 1 AND choice.last_candidate_group_count = 1 AND choice.first_progress_ratio < choice.last_progress_ratio ) ),
route_context AS ( SELECT selected.route_id, selected.route_fid, selected.route_name, selected.line_strategy, selected.source_start_progress_ratio, selected.source_end_progress_ratio,
/* * ORIGINAL_LINE 保留原始合并线路； * SUBSTRING_LINE 才执行空间截取。 */ CASE WHEN selected.line_strategy = 'ORIGINAL_LINE' THEN selected.original_metric_line
ELSE ST_LineSubstring( selected.original_metric_line, selected.source_start_progress_ratio, selected.source_end_progress_ratio ) END AS metric_line
FROM simulation_selected_route selected )
mapper.select:
WITH
SELECT route_id, route_fid, route_name, line_strategy, source_start_progress_ratio, source_end_progress_ratio,
ST_Length( metric_line ) AS total_length_meters
FROM route_context

WITH RECURSIVE simulation_original_route AS ( SELECT r.route_id,
ST_Transform( ST_LineMerge(r.geom), 32650 ) AS original_metric_line
FROM public.routes r
WHERE r.route_id = #{routeId} AND ST_GeometryType( ST_LineMerge(r.geom) ) = 'ST_LineString' ),
route_context AS ( SELECT route_id,
CASE WHEN CAST( #{sourceStartProgressRatio} AS double precision ) = 0.0 AND CAST( #{sourceEndProgressRatio} AS double precision ) = 1.0
THEN original_metric_line
ELSE ST_LineSubstring( original_metric_line,
CAST( #{sourceStartProgressRatio} AS double precision ),
CAST( #{sourceEndProgressRatio} AS double precision ) ) END AS metric_line
FROM simulation_original_route ),
route_segments AS (
SELECT rc.route_id, dump.path[1] AS segment_index, dump.geom AS segment_geom, ST_Length(dump.geom) AS segment_length_meters,
COALESCE( SUM(ST_Length(dump.geom)) OVER ( ORDER BY dump.path[1] ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING ), 0.0 ) AS segment_start_distance_meters
FROM route_context rc
CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_DumpSegments(rc.metric_line) AS dump ),
ordered_stops AS ( SELECT rs.route_id, rs.stop_id, s.stop_name, rs.stop_sequence,
ST_Transform( s.geom, 32650 ) AS metric_stop,
ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY rs.stop_sequence ) AS stop_order,
COUNT(*) OVER () AS stop_count
FROM public.route_stops rs
JOIN public.stops s ON s.stop_id = rs.stop_id
WHERE rs.route_id = #{routeId} ),
monotonic_stops AS (
SELECT os.*, rc.metric_line, ST_Length( rc.metric_line ) AS total_length_meters,
0.0::double precision AS progress_ratio
FROM ordered_stops os
JOIN route_context rc ON rc.route_id = os.route_id
WHERE os.stop_order = 1
UNION ALL
SELECT os.*, previous.metric_line, previous.total_length_meters,
CASE WHEN os.stop_order = os.stop_count THEN 1.0::double precision
/* 防止异常数据让中间站提前投影到终点后， 下一轮对零长度子线继续调用 ST_LineLocatePoint。 返回 1 不会掩盖问题：Java 的严格递增校验会拒绝它。 */ WHEN previous.progress_ratio >= 1.0 THEN 1.0::double precision
ELSE candidate.progress_ratio END AS progress_ratio
FROM monotonic_stops previous
JOIN ordered_stops os ON os.stop_order = previous.stop_order + 1
LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( /* 1. 每条线段产生一个精确的全局 progress 候选； 2. 只保留上一站之后且站点偏移不超过配置阈值的候选； 3. 将连续 segment_index 组成候选区间； 4. 选择最早区间中 snap_offset 最小的位置。
这样可以选择站序上更早的去程线段，同时不会简单取“刚进入 50 米范围”的区间边缘。 */ WITH candidate_segments AS ( SELECT ( segment.segment_start_distance_meters + segment.segment_length_meters * ST_LineLocatePoint( segment.segment_geom, os.metric_stop ) ) / previous.total_length_meters AS progress_ratio,
ST_Distance( segment.segment_geom, os.metric_stop ) AS snap_offset_meters,
segment.segment_index - ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( ORDER BY segment.segment_index ) AS candidate_group
FROM route_segments segment
WHERE ST_DWithin( segment.segment_geom, os.metric_stop, #{maximumSnapOffsetMeters} ) AND ( segment.segment_start_distance_meters + segment.segment_length_meters * ST_LineLocatePoint( segment.segment_geom, os.metric_stop ) ) / previous.total_length_meters > previous.progress_ratio ), ranked_candidates AS ( SELECT candidate_segments.*, MIN(progress_ratio) OVER ( PARTITION BY candidate_group ) AS candidate_group_start FROM candidate_segments ) SELECT progress_ratio FROM ranked_candidates ORDER BY candidate_group_start, snap_offset_meters, progress_ratio LIMIT 1 ) candidate ON os.stop_order < os.stop_count )
SELECT route_id, stop_id, stop_name, stop_sequence, progress_ratio,
total_length_meters * progress_ratio AS distance_along_route_meters,
ST_Distance( metric_stop,
ST_LineInterpolatePoint( metric_line, progress_ratio ) ) AS snap_offset_meters
FROM monotonic_stops
ORDER BY stop_sequence
